title: OpenAI recommends leaner skills and prompts for GPT-6 Astra
friendlyTitle: Newer coding agents may work better with fewer instructions
summary: OpenAI says older, heavily scripted agent instructions can hinder GPT-6 Astra. It recommends shorter skill descriptions, progressive disclosure, context-specific repository guidance, clear decision boundaries, and explicit definitions of completion.
friendlySummary: OpenAI says long and detailed prompt files can sometimes confuse GPT-6 Astra. It suggests keeping instructions short, relevant, and clear about when the job is truly finished.
whyItMatters: Teams should audit accumulated prompts instead of assuming that more instruction always produces better work. Removing obsolete scaffolding can reduce context use and contradictory guidance while preserving the boundaries and completion checks that still matter.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Cleaning up old prompts can make an agent faster and more reliable without removing important safety rules.
